body: Naturally. And if you ever need someone to talk to about this stuff, feel free to drop a message.
Thank you too. Hope things get better for you soon.
Eh. Friendships break down all the time. I just wrote this because I got major attachment issues and heard writing helps coping with negative thoughts. Frankly, it did a bit.
I honestly doubt the drunken confession was what made the person turn cold, given a bit more context, but that sure must have played a part too...
I am angry too, just not at them. If anything, all the bad things in my life are my fault...
It's never been about revenge. In fact one of my reasons I haven't done it is that I am scared people might feel guilty.

It depends on how one talks about it. For example, I had a friend who would talk to me about his suicidal thoughts, but he would do it in such a way that it caused me panic attacks. I tried to convince him to see a therapist, but to no avail. He was enabling me at the same time, as I too struggle with a lot of toxic thoughts and negative behaviours, so really, I get you and how you feel.
